pad_and_cat_tensors: pad a list of PyTorch tensors to the same sequence length and concatenate them along a specified dimension
pad_sequences_to_fixed_length: pad a list of tensors to a fixed sequence length using cat_pad_sequences with pad_to_len
pad_with_custom_value: pad a list of tensors using a custom pad_value instead of the default zero
concatenate_on_batch_dim: concatenate padded tensors along the batch dimension (cat_dim=0) after padding sequences
pad_multi_dim_tensors: pad multi-dimensional tensors along a custom sequence dimension using the seq_dim parameter
